jobs.title: Senior .NET / Azure Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for the special, unique and amazing YOU!

@ KCS IT, we look for the ones that stands out, for those that always wants to be better and fight for it, and for those who has the same values that we do: dedication, energy, integrity, transparency, flexibility, trust, honesty, hard work, proactivity, team work.
At KCS we stand for equality and value diversity. We create a safe, diverse environment where opportunities are equal for everyone! We do not discriminate based on age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, disability or any factor other than merit. All applications with skills for the position are welcome!
We are looking for an Amazing:
Senior .NET / Azure Solutions Engineer
Type of position: FULL REMOTE @ PORTUGAL

The amazing you, will have:

Strong hands-on experience with .NET
and Microsoft SQL Server;

Proven expertise in Microsoft Azure
and cloud-native architecture design;
Experience with distributed architectures
, microservices, system integrations, and containerization technologies;
Solid knowledge of Azure DevOps
, CI/CD practices, and deployment automation;
Experience with Infrastructure as Code
, particularly Terraform
and/or Bicep;

Strong understanding of security, compliance, and governance
within regulated environments;
Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams;
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;
Fluent English
(spoken and written).

Responsabilities:

Design and develop robust, secure, and scalable applications using .NET
and SQL Server;

Architect and implement cloud-native solutions
on Microsoft Azure;

Design and support distributed systems
, integrations, APIs, and containerized environments;
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines
using Azure DevOps
and automation best practices;
Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
solutions using Terraform
and/or Bicep;

Ensure compliance with security, governance, and regulatory requirements across cloud environments;
Collaborate with technical teams, product managers, and business stakeholders to define and deliver effective solutions aligned with business needs;
Contribute to architecture decisions, technical roadmaps, and continuous improvement initiatives;
Provide technical guidance and support to development and operations teams.

To turn yourself from amazing to unique, you´ll have (plus):

Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms.
Microsoft Azure certifications;
Experience working in highly regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government;
Knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Why should you become part of our family?

You can develop a career that fits you : your career development is personalized, taking in consideration your needs and goals from a short to long term

Interesting Challenges Ahead : you can work for several clients from different sectors of activity
Free training programs : Our training and certification programs in languages, tech, behavior and business will help you to reach your full potential faster
International projects in Benelux: you can gain international experience in Benelux and balance a new way of living with work
Type of projects (depending on the project you might find one of this types of projects):
In hybrid Systems: Is important to balance work with socialization, that´s why a hybrid system works for us and for you
Full Remote projects: If you want to work while you enjoy the comfort of your home
Full Onsite projects: if you prefer the company of your colleagues!
Take care of your well-being: Enjoy our free nutrition, psychologist, general medicine appointments and our yoga and personal training days… all remote!

Who are we?

Founded in 2008 and based in Lisbon, KCS IT is a consulting company in the field of Information Technology and Services, focused on creating value for our clients through three main areas: Consulting, Outsourcing, Innovation and Training. Our commitment to talent development is unmistakable in the recent opening of the Porto and Azores hubs, which aims to develop technology for the national and international market. Since 2018 we have been elected one of the 10 major companies in the “Index of Excellence”, an initiative that aims to reward organizations that invest most in the development and satisfaction of their employees.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
We are growing. And we are looking for talented people.

At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent.
We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives.

As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams.

We would like to meet a Cloud Engineer!

Responsibilities:

Validation of new reference architectures.
Support for projects and applications ensuring alignment with the reference architectures developed.
Creation and maintenance of detailed technical documentation.
Support for the end-to-end implementation of infrastructure and pipeline management for projects developed at Digital Factory, including provisioning, pipeline construction, and deployments.
Technical support and issue resolution for the various teams at Digital Factory.

Requirements:

Proven experience on setup and maintaining Azure infrastructure - production-ready and adhering to the best practices, namely:
Microsoft Azure Cloud:
* Proven experience developing and deploying applications on Azure
* Azure Functions and Logic Apps: Experience building serverless applications.
* Azure OpenAI Service: Experience with deploying and using models like GPT-4 and text embedding models.
* Azure AI Search / AI Foundry: Knowledge of creating and managing vector stores for similarity search.
* Data Factory and Databricks for ingestion pipelines
* Azure Blob Storage for cloud storage solutions
* CosmosDB: Knowledge of creating and managing long-term memory
* Application Insights: Knowledge of logging setup
* DevOps & MLOps:
* Proven CI/CD principles and scripting for automation, namely GitHub Actions.
* Proficiency with Docker for containerizing applications, Azure Container Registry as a plus.
* Experience deploying applications to multiple environments (e.g., dev, production) on Azure.
* Secrets management using Azure Key Vault, GitHub and HashiCorp Vault
* API and External Services Integration
* Setting REST APIs based on WebApps (Fast API) and Azure Functions.
* Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, Azure AD, and token-based authentication.
* Management Tools
* ServiceNow: good knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent) for ticket registration and tracking
* Jira/Confluence: good knowledge of Jira for activity tracking.
Proven ability to track and supervise the resolution of several ongoing issues (using Kanban/Scrum) with good organization skills and ability to provide status feedback
Good communication skills and ability to obtain results from other teams
Autonomous and problem solver
Good level English.

Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously.

Find with us the right opportunity to grow!

What you can expect from us

Long-term projects with national and international context.
Opportunities to grow technically and professionally.
A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust.
Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability.

Send us your CV in English to cesaltina.abreu@decskill.com with reference “CA/ CloudEngineer”.

Your next challenge might start here.
Join us!

We promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, where recruitment and career progression are based solely on talent, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality, or any other form of discrimination incompatible with human dignity.

jobs.title: Senior Dotnet Developer
jobs.description:
nineDots is building a shortlist for a planned two-year, full-time software development engagement with a client in Bahrain. The appointment is subject to contract award and final client approval.

You’ll develop and improve existing applications, build integrations, resolve issues and keep systems reliable. This suits someone who enjoys hands-on delivery and taking responsibility for their work from development through to production support.

What you’ll work on
• Design, develop, test and maintain .NET applications.
• Improve existing features and integrate applications with related systems.
• Investigate issues, document changes and support releases.
• Work with technical and business stakeholders to turn requirements into working software.

What we need
• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
• At least two years of senior-level .NET development experience.
• Clear examples of applications you have personally developed, tested and supported.

C#, APIs, databases and production troubleshooting are useful strengths. We’ll discuss the detailed technology stack during the process.

Bahraini applicants are particularly encouraged to apply. We also welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates able to work in Bahrain.

Apply with your CV, current location, notice period and monthly salary expectations in BHD. Please include a short example of a .NET application you have delivered and your own responsibilities.

Client details, package and working arrangements will be discussed with shortlisted applicants.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Working Model:
Hybrid Working or Remote
Employment Status:
Full-time, Permanent
Working hours:
Monday to Friday
Office Location:
Sofia, Bulgaria
Reporting to:
Head of
Engineering, Bulgaria

Picture yourself at the cutting edge of payments innovation, where each project has the potential to transform the industry. We’re on a dynamic path to redefine what’s possible, with a powerful portfolio that’s set to surpass the competition and position us as a global leader. This is your chance to join us at a pivotal moment in our journey—where your work can make an extraordinary impact.

If you've ever dreamed of being part of something remarkable from the beginning, this is your opportunity. As we grow, your role will shape the future, impact customers worldwide, and drive us toward becoming a game-changer in payments. Join us, and let’s create something truly groundbreaking together.

In this role you will add value to PXP by:

As a Senior Software Engineer (AI) at PXP, you’ll play a key role in developing and maintaining the technology that powers our payment platform. This is a hands-on, collaborative position where you’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and refine high-performance applications in a fast-paced, agile environment.

While your day-to-day focus will be on our core backend systems, we are looking for an engineer with a strong structural understanding of AI agent orchestration. Your familiarity with how automated agent systems execute tasks, manage state, and call external tools will help ensure our platform's foundational code is built to seamlessly support and interact with these modern AI workflows.

A typical week might involve:

Designing, developing, and maintaining core payment software applications on the PXP platform.
Implementing high-quality, maintainable code using C# .NET Framework (and transitioning to C# .NET Core) ensuring that systems are structured cleanly to act as deterministic tools for future AI orchestration layers.
Creating and maintaining SQL Server stored procedures, optimized for a heavily multithreaded and highly concurrent environment.
Collaborating with teams to gather requirements and define technical solutions across our broader ecosystem.
Writing unit tests, leveraging TDD/BDD principles, and conducting code reviews to maintain high-quality engineering standards.
Actively participating in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
Tracking industry trends and emerging technologies, specifically noticing how modern enterprise software structures integrate with agentic AI ecosystems

We are looking for someone who:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Solid hands-on experience with C# .NET Framework (and/or .NET Core) and SQL Server.
Strong familiarity with design patterns and flow-based processing. Crucially, you possess a solid conceptual understanding of AI agent orchestration (state machines, loop handling, tool-calling boundaries) rather than just basic prompt generation.
Strong understanding of TDD and BDD principles, with experience using tools like SpecFlow.
Experience with Git and a solid understanding of the Gitflow workflow.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and strong communication skills.

We would love someone to have any of the following:

Online payments and financial systems
Understanding of the challenges in an enterprise, multi-server, multithreading information system

What we can offer you:

You will be joining us at a pivotal moment, where your contributions will directly shape our growth and future success, setting you on the ground floor of something extraordinary.

At PXP, we don’t just offer a job—we offer an opportunity to build something extraordinary. You’ll work on transformative projects, collaborate with passionate colleagues, and see the tangible impact of your efforts on our journey to becoming a global payments leader.

Growth Opportunities:
Be part of a company with an ambitious vision, where your role evolves as the company grows.
Cutting-Edge Environment:
Work with the latest tools and technologies to drive innovation in the payments industry.
Collaborative Culture:
Join a supportive team that values creativity, collaboration, and shared success.
Flexibility: Benefit from hybrid or remote working options that allow you to balance professional and personal priorities, depending on your location.
Competitive Package:
Enjoy a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a range of benefits tailored to your location.
Impactful Work:
Play a critical role in shaping the future of payments and making a difference for customers worldwide.

About us

PXP is a well-established and respected name within the card payment industry.
We boast an impressive and diverse client database across the globe and have over 30 years of experience within the payments space.

Our people are employed across our regional offices located in the UK, Austria, Bulgaria, India and the US.

PXP are a leading payment provider with a reputation for a reliable payment and acquiring platform, as well as offering operational excellence and best-in-class service for all of our clients.

Take your career to the next level and join us as we redefine the payments industry. With our CARE values at the core of everything we do, let’s innovate together.

CARE: Customer at our Core, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence.

These principles guide everything we do, from how we interact with our customers to how we support one another as a team.
